# awesome-dsh-plugins

> A curated directory of DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) plugins — 14 categories, 300+ entries, each with GitHub ⭐ stars and a `dsh plugin add` install command. Bilingual (English + 中文), machine-readable data, auto-sync CI. Community-maintained; not affiliated with DeepSeek.

DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) is DeepSeek's open-source "everything is a plugin" agent harness. This repository organizes its community plugins, scattered across GitHub, into 14 top-level categories.

## Key files

- [README.md](README.md) — English primary README with inline collapsible browsing of all plugins
- [README.zh.md](README.zh.md) — 中文版
- [INDEX.md](INDEX.md) — flat list of all plugin entries (for full-text search)
- [data/plugins.json](data/plugins.json) — machine-readable data: 365 entries (`fullName`, `url`, `stars`, `npmName`, `license`, `category`)
- [data/taxonomy.json](data/taxonomy.json) — 14-category taxonomy (single source of truth)
- [docs/taxonomy.md](docs/taxonomy.md) — category definitions & boundaries
- [docs/reconcile.md](docs/reconcile.md) — data-vs-directory reconciliation report
- [docs/wishlist.md](docs/wishlist.md) — ecosystem gaps (database, translation, …)
- [docs/journey.md](docs/journey.md) — project evolution record (architecture changes & key decisions)
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) — how to add a plugin

## Categories

`tools` · `skills` · `mcp` · `ui-themes` · `desktop-tui-mobile` · `agent-orchestration` · `context-memory` · `multimodal` · `workflow-automation` · `notifications-channels` · `browser-search` · `infrastructure-dev` · `fun-other` · `official-meta`

## Install a plugin

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add <pkg>
```
